note: Fixed user messages and scripted replies. Never show graders or run agents anything else.
deliverables: Every case asks for a reply, planning documents and a rendered page or screen (index.html), so all arms are judged on the same kinds of output.

Keep Escalations and Desk help like they are (crop 2) and keep Record donation (crop 3). Remove 'Filter: All Attendees' (crop 4). In progress needs a 'View all' option or a way to clear it (crop 5). Selected row should have a clean border all around, not the thick left bar, and remove 'Query: Test' (crop 6). Remove 'Synced to event sheet'. Profile only at bottom left, remove the box at the top right. Remove the Checked In and In Queue counters for now, and the Name / Phone, Scan QR, Family ID tabs. Remove the printer and badge stock panel. We are only doing registration now, check-in comes later. Rebuild the screen with these changes as index.html.
